/products.name: Himalayan Green Tea
/products.pitch: A clean, fresh green tea with gentle grassy notes, grown on Himalayan slopes. Light enough for every day, with a calm, mindful finish.
brew: Add 1 tsp of tea to 150–180 ml of water at 80–85°C
Add lemon or honey if you like
why: Pairs well with a light breakfast

/products.name: Hibiscus Green Tea
/products.pitch: Smooth green tea meets ruby hibiscus petals: floral, lightly tangy, lovely hot or over ice.
brew: Add 1 tsp of tea to just-boiled water
Drink warm or chilled, plain or with a little honey
why: Bright ruby colour in the cup

Add lemon or honey if you like

/products.name: Pure Mint Lemongrass Black Tea
/products.pitch: Bold black tea lifted with mint and lemongrass: an energising cup that is just as good over ice.
brew: Add 1 tsp of tea to 150–180 ml of water at 80–85°C

why: A premium upgrade at a small price step
